description: Create a new API key for a company, typically when setting up a Sequenzy integration in a project. The CLI reads the key from the SEQUENZY_API_KEY environment variable; SDK clients accept it through the apiKey option, such as apiKey: process.env.SEQUENZY_API_KEY. The key is returned only once at creation time and cannot be retrieved later.

companyId.description: Company ID to create the key for

name.description: Optional name for the API key (e.g., 'Production', 'Development')

preset.description: Optional permission preset. Supported values: full_access, read_only, agent_safe, ai_drafting, data_ingest_safe, data_ingest_automations, transactional_sender, marketing_sender. Defaults to full_access when both preset and scopes are omitted; prefer agent_safe when creating a key for an AI agent.

scopes.description: Optional explicit API key permission scopes. If provided, this overrides preset and must include at least one supported scope.

name: create_api_key

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `create_api_key` MCP tool.

apiKey.description: Created API key metadata: the newly created secret in `key`, plus `scopes` listing the assigned permission scopes (null when the key has full access).

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

key.description: Newly created API key if the API response uses the short key field.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
